data.title: Pearl House III
data.about:
Pearl House III is an 11-story residential building located in Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC). You can choose from studio, 1, and 2-bedroom apartments. The floor plan of the building also includes 4 podum levels. Designed by an award-winning interior designer, the Pearl House 3 project by Imtiaz Developments offers elegant and sophisticated spaces for modern urban living. 

Pearl House 3 at JVC Dubai is an architectural gem inspired by the timeless beauty of pearls. The development is conveniently located within walking distance of Al Khail Mall, offering residents easy accessibility and convenience.

characteristics_module.title: Discover Refined Living at Pearl House III
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• A dazzling residential masterpiece by Imtiaz Developments, offering a selection of fully furnished studios, 1, and 2-bedroom apartments.
  • Located in the heart of JVC, a family-oriented community that provides an elegant lifestyle with world-class amenities.
  • Sleek and modern homes adorned with top-of-the-line appliances and finishes, featuring color schemes inspired by nature.
  • Excellent facilities within the building, including a zen garden, rooftop swimming pool, and a gym.

location_tile.title: Elevate Your Lifestyle at Pearl House III
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Pearl House 3 location in Jumeirah Village Circle offers numerous benefits for residents. As a centrally located community in Dubai, JVC provides easy access to major highways like Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Khail Road, ensuring convenient connectivity to key destinations across the city. 
This prime location allows residents to reach popular areas such as Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and Dubai International Airport within a short drive. Additionally, the community is well-served by public transportation, making commuting hassle-free for those who prefer not to drive.

Al Khail Road within Walking Distance
5 minutes to Circle Mall
10 minutes to Dubai Butterfly Garden
20 minutes to Downtown Dubai
